recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective photograph of a group of people in 1970s attire positioned on and around railway tracks, flanked by large freight cars. The composition is topped with heavy, stencil-style display typography and a central oval graphic device.
coreVisualRelationships: Converging railway lines creating deep linear perspective
Human figures scaled against massive industrial freight cars
Heavy black display type anchoring the top edge
Central oval badge acting as a secondary focal point above the group
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subjects
Industrial railway setting with gravel and steel textures
1970s fashion including flared denim and afros

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six to seven figures distributed across the middle ground, scaled to appear small against the trains but central to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy black stencil text at the top and the converging tracks at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the tracks from the bottom center upward toward the group, then rises to the oval badge and finally the main title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the upper third provides a clean backdrop for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (brown gravel, rusted steel) and sky blue.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for typography and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal/green and red within the freight car graphics and central badge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, film-like saturation with high value in the sky and deep shadows under the trains.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance
Stick to 1970s film stock color profiles

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Stencil-style vertical cuts through the strokes
Tight letter spacing (touching in some areas)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods and punctuation integrated into the baseline of the letters
Stencil gaps placed at consistent horizontal intervals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy stencil display paired with a clean, condensed sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Chrome-effect oval badge with rivet details
Colored circular indicators (green and red) within the badge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and industrial stencil aesthetic.
Appropriate for the secondary text inside the oval badge.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a group of people in 70s denim and afros standing on gravel railroad tracks between two large freight trains (one dark blue, one teal). The perspective is low, looking up toward a clear, bright sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy black stencil-style title across the top sky area. Below it, centered, add a silver chrome oval badge containing stacked condensed sans-serif text with a green dot above and a red dot below.

verificationChecks: Are the stencil cuts in the main title clearly visible?
Is the denim fashion historically accurate to the mid-70s?
Does the oval badge have a metallic, riveted appearance?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific placement of the stencil cuts
mustRedesign: Unique freight company branding on the train cars
Identifiable faces of the original artists

mustAchieve: Authentic 70s film grain and color balance

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tracks converge naturally toward the horizon.
Check that the stencil font does not look like a standard 'Army' stencil.
Verify the chrome badge looks integrated into the scene.
Confirm the sky is clear enough to support the black text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Perspective + 70s Group Portrait + Heavy Stencil Display + Metallic Badge Device
